To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a capacitive EKG system with 9 electrodes and 4 channels is feasible.
a capacitive EGG system is capable to measure the ECG with high quality and that the diagnostic relevance of the system is comparable to the one of standard ECG measurement systems.
the capacitive ECG sensor array allows the recording of standard ECG leads, that the system can be operated in an unobtrusive way and that the system can provide visual patient feedback.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a capacitive EKG measurement system which allows for the recording of the standard ECG leads according the Einthoven and the Goldberger system.
the development of a capacitive multi-channel electrode array for ECG measurement.

three major issues: (1) the capacitive measurement principle, (2) the design and realization of a capacitive EECG array and (3) the development of a graphical user interface to provide the patient with a visual feedback of his heart activity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this system is able to provide a reliable measurement of the ECG signal and that it is able to measure the ECG signals in accordance to the standardized Einthoven and modified Goldberger leads.
the capacitive multi-channel measurement system introduced in this paper is able to record standardized ECGs with high quality.
the system presented here can be seen as a first approach towards a multi-channel capacitive ECG system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a system for capacitive ECG measurements with a high diagnostic significance was realized.
we have successfully implemented a capacitive EKG system which allows the acquisition of the standard EKG signals.
we have developed an ECG system which allows the acquisition of a standard 12-lead ECG with a single electrode array and a single electrode.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the capacitive ECG system is able to record ECG signals comparable to a standard ECG system.
a capacitive EKG system with visual feedback is feasible.
the capacitive ECG signal is of diagnostic relevance and that a capacitive EGG measurement system is able to record a standardized ECG signal.
